why: Jeans, a camisole, a relaxed cardigan and suede plimsolls are the only combination that sits inside the casual level of an unhurried 18°C weekend walk, where every other outfit is flagged as dressier than the occasion. I accept that no register leads, that the mint headband is a lone accent (I declared it the single focus, with the milky bag kept quiet on purpose), that the plimsoll edge is pale against the skin and so barely cuts the leg line, and that the cardigan is pricey, since it can be worn in many outfits.
